veranderings.voor: dieselfde suiker as die suiker in julle suikerpot
veranderings.na: dieselfde suiker as dié in julle suikerpot
veranderings.rede: Avoids repeating 'suiker' three times in one short sentence.
'bokant' is the natural Afrikaans noun for the upper surface; 'boonste kant' reads wooden.

veranderings.voor: uit die grond op en dun buisies
veranderings.na: uit die grond op, en dun buisies
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: om te lewe en te groei en verander 'n ander deel in stysel
veranderings.na: om te lewe en te groei. 'n Ander deel verander hy in stysel
veranderings.rede: The chain of three 'en' links makes the sentence hard to follow; splitting it keeps the meaning and reads more clearly.

veranderings.voor: Dit verskil van plant tot plant watter dele die meeste bêre.
veranderings.na: Watter dele die meeste stysel bêre, verskil van plant tot plant.
veranderings.rede: The anticipatory 'Dit' and bare 'die meeste bêre' are vague; naming stysel and putting the subject clause first is clearer.
'met ... in' is colloquial; standard written Afrikaans uses 'daarin' here.

veranderings.voor: om kos mee te maak nie en die jong plantjie
veranderings.na: om kos mee te maak nie, en die jong plantjie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: uit sy kos, en ook 'n dier wat die plant eet
veranderings.na: uit sy kos, en 'n dier wat die plant eet, kry dit ook
veranderings.rede: The tacked-on phrase without its own verb reads awkwardly; giving it a verb makes a proper second clause that justifies the comma.
